recipes.name: flux2-klein-4b-edit
open_questions: Transformer_edit / _edit_2ref / _edit_512 come from in-context-editing code added to the
diffusion pipeline in the patched coreai-models checkout — commits d982f48 (Flux2Pipeline.
editImages + transformer_edit export + runner --edit-image) and bc48d3d (multi-reference,
transformer_edit_2ref). That code lives in coreai_models/diffusion/{components,flux2}.py.
It IS in the overlay as of 2026-07-25 (regen.sh), so the code is reproducible now — what is
still unrecorded is the invocation: which flag selects the edit transformer, how the 2ref and
512 variants are requested, and whether they were exported in one run or three.

recipes.name: glm-4.7-flash
open_questions: Was --head-sym / --head-quant passed? Asked and closed as unknowable on 2026-07-25: the owner
does not recall, and nothing published records it — the bundle name omits the head flags, the
metadata declares no compression, and unlike embeddinggemma this repo ships no reference.json.
For the twin port (qwen3.6-35b-a3b) knowledge/ recorded a bare `sym8`, but that is not evidence
for this one. Settling it needs a re-export of the lm_head under both settings and a byte
comparison against the published 30 GB bundle — the only remaining route. `sym8` alone (the
args above) is the defensible partial record until then.

recipes.name: lfm2.5-vl-450m
open_questions: On device the image path drops one adjective vs fp32 at a near-tie (same picture, same
middle ten tokens); the device gate checks the device-verified sequence.
The baked square grid stretches non-square images, which is the one thing NaFlex avoids.
No gate here can see that cost: the fixed-grid oracle is captured through the same stretch.

recipes.name: lfm2.5-vl-3b
open_questions: int8lin is the Mac ship (AOT resources.bin 3.13 GiB, does not load on iOS); int4lin at
2.03 GiB DOES load -- iPhone 17 Pro 27.5 prefill / 19.3-22.8 decode, nat 16/16 + image
oracle 24/24, PB_G=1024 clean. The repo note had the wall at 2 GiB; 2.03 was expected to
fail and did not, so the bracket is now 2.03 OK / 3.92 not.
The baked square grid stretches non-square images, as on the 450M, and no gate sees it.

recipes.name: north-micro-vision
open_questions: The baked square grid stretches non-square images; upstream is native-resolution and kept
the fixture's own 30x40 grid. No gate here sees that cost.
int4lin is NOT published: 0/9 suite cases with repetition and instruction-boilerplate leaks.

recipes.name: qwen3.8-27b-vl
open_questions: The baked 512x512 square grid stretches non-square images (same trade as LFM2.5-VL);
the fixed-grid oracle cannot see that cost.
Decode via the VLM bundle measures 15.2 tok/s vs 15.7 on the text bundle — python-
driver step overhead, not graph cost; an engine-side host would close it.

recipes.name: shieldstral-s512
open_questions: int4's error is concentrated on the one case fp32 did not saturate (JA violence 0.9011 ->
0.9315). Verdicts at a 0.5 threshold are unaffected; a 0.9 threshold would be. Tune against
the shipped bundle, not fp32.
The checkpoint's Pixtral vision tower (image_size 1540) is NOT ported -- text only.
